remarks: Enjoy the comfort and convenience of this Cape-style home located on a quiet cul-de-sac in a desirable location. Exceptional combination of comfort, convenience and easy living. Sidewalks provide a wonderful connection to both the schools and town, making this an ideal location! The inviting open floor plan creates an effortless flow for everyday living. The first-floor primary bedroom offers the ease of one-level living, while two spacious bedrooms on the second floor provide flexibility for family, guests, or home office. Backyard is shared with other unit. Rent includes lawn care, snow removal and the water bill providing effortless, low maintenance living!
